searchBudgetNote: The shared WebSearch budget (200 calls per turn across all agents) was already used up when this agent started. Seven search attempts returned 'web search was not performed'. No search query actually ran, so the queries array is empty. All discovery below was done by opening well-known institutional websites directly with WebFetch, which biases coverage towards a handful of large Nairobi institutions.

candidates.name: Nairobi Serena Hotel - Maisha Health Club & Spa

evidence.quote: Complimentary access is available for all in-house guests.
Enjoy daily access to wellness with the Maisha Membership, ideal for residents, diplomats and frequent travellers.

candidates.notes: Nairobi page pairs the gym with an aerobics studio, sauna, steam room and juice bar and says spa bookings go to maisha.nairobi@serenahotels.com. Group-wide wellness page advertises a Maisha Membership with 'Unlimited gym and pool access' but does not say whether it is available at the Nairobi hotel or to non-residents, and shows no day-pass or hours. coverageNotes: Search was unavailable (shared WebSearch budget exhausted before this agent ran; no queries ran), and a later account session limit also cut off some fetches. Work was limited to opening institutional sites directly. Covered with evidence: Karen Country Club, Weston Hotel, Safari Park Hotel, Nairobi Serena Hotel, Eka Hotel, USIU-Africa (all Nairobi). Opened but no gym facts: Kabarak University sports page (sports listed, no gym; seed already has a Kabarak fitness centre), Egerton, Riara, CUEA, Panari Hotel, Tribe Hotel (spa only, no gym mentioned). Not reachable or blocked (403/503/DNS/timeout): University of Nairobi, JKUAT, Strathmore, Mount Kenya University, Sarova, Hilton, Radisson Blu, Nairobi Club, Muthaiga Country Club (guessed domains did not resolve), Hemingways, Nakuru Sports Club (guessed domain did not resolve). Not researched at all: country and sports clubs outside Karen/Impala (Mombasa, Nakuru, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nanyuki, Thika, Naivasha clubs), coast and safari resort hotels, county-level university campuses (Moi, Maseno, Egerton, Chuka, Karatina, MMUST etc.), corporate and estate gyms accepting outside members, and every county outside Nairobi. This file should be treated as a small partial result, not a survey of the group; a follow-up run with search available is needed.
